**难度**: ★★★☆☆

**分值**: 2分

## 题目内容

40. What does the passage imply?
A. Honesty is the best policy.
B. Technologies can be double-edited.
C. There are more solutions than problems.
D. Credibility holds the key to development.

## 选项

A. A. Honesty is the best policy.

B. B. Technologies can be double-edited.

C. C. There are more solutions than problems.

D. D. Credibility holds the key to development.

---

## 参考答案

D
